A grounded order book

Source: R/orderbook.R
order_book.Rd

The object bourse_orderbook() returns on success. It carries the bids and asks price/quantity ladders (each a data.frame of price, qty), the obs_schema describing each column's quantity and unit, and the grounding label combined worst-case from the facts it rests on. bids are sorted best (highest) first and asks best (lowest) first, the convention the validator enforces.

Usage

order_book(
  bids = NULL,
  asks = NULL,
  symbol = NA_character_,
  source = NA_character_,
  last_update_id = NA_real_,
  obs_schema = NULL,
  grounding = "[unverified]",
  metadata = list()
)

Arguments

bids

A data.frame of resting buy orders (price, qty).

asks

A data.frame of resting sell orders (price, qty).

symbol

The instrument symbol (e.g. "BTCUSDT").

source

The data source (e.g. "binance").

last_update_id

The exchange's order-book sequence id, when known.

obs_schema

A data.frame of (name, quantity, unit) per column.

grounding

A canonical grounding token.

metadata

A named list of free-form metadata.

Value

An order_book S7 object.

See also

Other orderbook: bourse_orderbook()

Examples

ob <- order_book(
  bids = data.frame(price = 100, qty = 1), asks = data.frame(price = 101, qty = 2),
  symbol = "X", source = "demo", grounding = grounding_unverified())
ob@symbol
#> [1] "X"
